description: Chemical plant operators – safety-critical, industrial, dependability and safety focus

description: Bilingual healthcare admin staff – Spanish-speaking, HIPAA compliance, hybrid English/Spanish battery

messages.content: We're hiring bilingual healthcare admin staff in South Texas — they handle patient records and need to be assessed in Spanish. HIPAA compliance is critical. What assessments work?
There's a catalog constraint: HIPAA, Medical Terminology, and Microsoft Word tests are English-only. Personality measures support Latin American Spanish. Are candidates functionally bilingual?
They're functionally bilingual — English fluent for written work. Go with the hybrid.

description: Senior Full-Stack Engineer JD – backend-leaning, Java/Spring/SQL primary, full battery

messages.content:
Here's the JD for an engineer we need to fill.

"Senior Full-Stack Engineer — 5+ years across Core Java, Spring, REST API design, Angular, SQL/relational databases, AWS deployment, and Docker. Will own end-to-end microservice delivery, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor mid-level engineers. Strong CI/CD and cloud-native experience required."
That JD spans seven distinct areas. Is this backend-leaning, frontend-heavy, or a true balanced full-stack role?
Backend-leaning. Day-one priorities are Core Java and Spring; SQL is constant. Angular is occasional — they'd review frontend PRs but not own features.
Understood. Is the seniority closer to a senior IC or a tech lead?
Senior IC. They lead design on their own services but don't manage other engineers directly.

description: Senior Full-Stack Engineer – user drops REST, adds AWS and Docker

messages.content:
Here's the JD for an engineer we need to fill.

"Senior Full-Stack Engineer — 5+ years across Core Java, Spring, REST API design, Angular, SQL/relational databases, AWS deployment, and Docker. Will own end-to-end microservice delivery, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor mid-level engineers."
Is this backend-leaning, frontend-heavy, or balanced?
Backend-leaning. Core Java and Spring are primary; SQL is constant. Angular is occasional.
Is the seniority closer to a senior IC or a tech lead?
Senior IC.
Here is a first shortlist: Core Java (Advanced), Spring, RESTful Web Services, SQL, Verify G+, OPQ32r.
Add AWS and Docker. Drop REST — the API design signal will already come through in Spring and the live interview.

Drop the OPQ. Final list: Verify G+ and Graduate Scenarios.
